name: Agent-based model of regeneration in healthy and mdx skeletal muscle
description: An agent-based model of skeletal muscle that predicts the regenerative response of muscle cells, fibroblasts, satellite stem cells and inflammatory cells to contraction-induced injury. Parameters were calibrated and validated against published experimental measurements, and the model was used to test how factors associated with Duchenne muscular dystrophy, such as altered fibroblast or satellite stem cell behaviour, influence regeneration in healthy and mdx mouse muscle.
spatial_context: Injured skeletal muscle in which individual cells interact; recovery is measured as muscle cross-sectional area.

references.title: Agent-based model illustrates the role of the microenvironment in regeneration in healthy and mdx skeletal muscle.

prediction_scope: Satellite stem cell counts and recovery of muscle cross-sectional area over the 28 days after injury.
